title: Semantic-aware Occlusion Filtering Neural Radiance Fields in the Wild
heroTitle: Semantic-aware Occlusion Filtering Neural Radiance Fields in the Wild
overview: SF-NeRF reconstructs neural scene representations from a small number of unconstrained, in-the-wild photographs with changing illumination and transient occluders.
The method adds a DINO-guided FilterNet that separates transient appearance from the static radiance field, making robust few-shot reconstruction possible with limited tourist-photo observations.
contributions: Built and evaluated the project baselines for few-shot NeRF reconstruction in unconstrained image collections.
Contributed to the research discussion around semantic guidance, transient decomposition, and evaluation design.
Analyzed reconstruction quality against Latent NeRF and NeRF-W under limited training views.
description: Robust radiance fields for online image collections
keywords: SF-NeRF, Neural Radiance Fields, NeRF in the Wild, Few-shot NeRF, Transient Occlusion, DINO
